biography.bio:
V.E.N.O.M.'s founder: a former partner of Matt Trakker who chose profit over everything, and still hates losing to him.

Masks: Viper, Python, Flexor, Raynet, Ripper, New Viper (wearing Viper).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.ffhYSqwK5K6EeqFd]{Buzzard}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.xDe6xYaRrP3byWgu]{Outlaw}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.IRy5zORmOvhXPexy]{Ratfang}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.L13xwGuKcY0z6Dog]{Switchblade}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.9jNwsSQL7vMErRzA]{Venom's Revenge}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.bcAxe5y5rLTyZ4NB]{Wolfbeast}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.m7pgQ05qrxnyauJB]{Wolfbeast Shuttle}.

V.E.N.O.M. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Throws out a flexible energy shield in front of the wearer.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

steps.text: {name} throws up a flexible energy shield.

automation.notes: Flex Shield (a Move action): +2 Evasion and +2 Toughness until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
V.E.N.O.M.'s leader wears a snake-headed mask that spits a cloud of corrosive poison.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the target's Toughness: 1 Poison damage (Apply Damage button) and Poisoned on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A beam of energy that shreds metal - armor included.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. A hit also strips the target's armor (Armor Stripped). Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A Laser Command mask that fires a net of energy rays.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the target's Evasion; a hit leaves it Restrained until the end of its next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
The upgraded Viper: its poison, plus a holographic double.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You never fight fair. Once per scene, as a free action, line up a cheap shot: your next attack this turn is upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Use button: once per scene, marks you until the end of your turn. Your next attack is upshifted once and uses the mark up.

system.description:
Money opens doors. Once per mission, your fortune or your contacts produce something the team needs: a ride, a plane ticket, a building pass, a piece of gear.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

steps.text: {name} pulls some strings - money talks. (GM: a vehicle, travel or a piece of gear of Standard Availability or lower turns up.)

automation.notes:
Use button: once per mission, posts it to chat.

Left to the table: what turns up.

system.description:
Fires a gripping wire that wraps around its target.

Miles Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the target's Evasion; a hit leaves it Grappled. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.
